status: Controlled architecture ablation protocol on repaired frozen Stage 1 splits

full.name: FULL
full.description: Complete BioNutriGPT architecture: feature tokenization with modality embeddings, 3-layer Transformer, learned modality attention poolers, 4-expert sparse MoE (top-2), and shortcut-augmented disease heads.

no_moe.name: NO_MOE
no_moe.description: Replaces 4-expert sparse MoE with a single dense feed-forward network (512 -> 256 -> 256) matching the activation (GELU) and dropout (0.1) conventions. MoE balancing loss is set to 0.

mean_pooling.name: MEAN_POOLING
mean_pooling.description: Replaces learned modality attention pooling with an ordinary group mean of each modality's Transformer output tokens. 4 modality summaries remain in R^128.

no_modality_embeddings.name: NO_MODALITY_EMBEDDINGS
no_modality_embeddings.description: Removes only the learned modality embedding vectors from tokenization. Feature-specific linear weights and biases remain.

no_head_shortcuts.name: NO_HEAD_SHORTCUTS
no_head_shortcuts.description: Removes additional modality summaries from disease prediction heads. All heads receive only the 256-dimensional patient representation u via Linear(256, 64).

training.loss: unweighted binary cross-entropy averaged equally over three targets (diabetes, obesity, cvd)

selection: Highest validation mean AUROC across diabetes and CVD; ties choose earliest epoch.
calibration: One prespecified unpenalized logistic recalibrator per outcome, fitted on calibration logits only after model selection. Evaluated on temporal predictions.
evaluation: Temporal cohort evaluation (N=7,004). Primary metrics: diabetes raw AUROC, CVD raw AUROC, diabetes calibrated Brier, CVD calibrated Brier. Secondary: obesity metrics, average precision, raw Brier, log-loss, calibration intercept/slope, compute/memory.

statistical_analysis.method: Two-axis paired bootstrap across participants (N=7,004) and seeds (K=5).
statistical_analysis.contrasts: FULL minus ablation (positive AUROC favors FULL, negative Brier favors FULL).
confidence_intervals: Bonferroni-adjusted percentile interval for 16 primary contrasts [0.15625%, 99.84375%]
